name: westwood_online_upgrade_download_event_sink_progress
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownloadEventSink::OnDownloadProgress updates the progress-bar position and reports byte-count status text with an optional seconds-left suffix.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The wider download event-sink vtable is still under reconstruction; this target verifies the callback body directly.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x4426b0 validates a five-argument stdcall callback. It uses bytesRead and totalBytes to call imported SendDlgItemMessageA(g_hWestwoodOnlineUpgradeProgressDialog, 1021, PBM_SETPOS, (bytesRead * 100) / totalBytes, 0), ignores the fourth argument, branches on secondsLeft > 0, formats the byte-count status text through WestwoodOnlineUpgradeProgressDialog::SetStatusTextFmt, returns S_OK in eax, and pops five stack arguments.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_download_event_sink_progress_smoke patches USER32 SendDlgItemMessageA and SetDlgItemTextA, then verifies the progress-bar control id, PBM_SETPOS message, percent math, lParam zero, both status text branches, progress HWND, control id 1023, global status buffer pointer, ignored fourth argument, and S_OK returns.
